verdicts.reason: A is an almost exact copy of the original at a slightly taller size. The title block stays in place, the hatched rules frame 'Should You' cleanly and the yellow ribbon CTA is intact, though it is a near-copy and not a real rearrangement. In B, the top hatched rule has slid left and stretched across the photo, cutting through the arm and the bottle cap. That is an obvious unwanted collision, and it breaks the framing of 'Should You', which no longer has a rule above it.
